metadata.summary: Jitin ordered an Avocado Toast and a Breakfast Bundle from Manhattan Bagel

messages.text: Hello Jitin, welcome to Manhattan Bagel. It's great to see you again. What would you like to order?
I want to order, avocado toast and breakfast bundle.
The Avocado Toast and Breakfast Bundle, excellent choices. Let me get the options for your Avocado Toast first.
I hope you are still with me!
